data.title: Call with Bram
data.transcript: Speaker 1: About the reunion dinner: I'm ninety days sober now, and I'd rather not be somewhere with an open bar. Not many people know I was in treatment. Speaker 2: I'm proud of you, Bram. Leave it with me. Speaker 1: Thanks. Could you find somewhere that doesn't centre on drinks? Speaker 2: I'll book an alcohol-free venue for the reunion by next week. Speaker 1: That means a lot.
